statement: Let H be a simply connected semisimple group over a number field k. Then H1(kv, H) = 1 at every nonarchimedean place. A torsor X under H that has a point over every completion of k has a k-point. Moreover, X(k) is dense in Q v∈B X(kv) for every finite set B of places.
